title: Flood proximity response machine
description: Allowed emergency response states for a site near flooding. CEL names speakable states and transitions. Consumer policy (for example VITO) decides when a named event fires. This machine is not an OIDF commissioning SAT, not a CAP alert, and carries no evidence gates.

states.label: Monitor
states.description: Watch the incident. No extra site posture is implied.

states.label: Escalate
states.description: Elevated attention. Notify or review per consumer policy.

states.label: Isolate load
states.description: Non-life-safety load isolation is an allowed posture. CEL does not trip breakers.

states.label: Shelter
states.description: Life-safety / shelter posture. CEL does not issue the directive.

states.label: Recover
states.description: Hazard receding. Return path toward monitor.

transitions.description: Flood threat is near enough that consumer policy raises attention.
Proximity no longer meets the consumer watch threshold.
Policy authorizes isolating non-life-safety load. Thresholds live in the consumer.
Load isolation lifted while the incident remains in watch.
Life-safety shelter posture from elevated watch.
Life-safety shelter posture from load-isolated posture.
Return to routine monitoring after recovery.
